parole.significato: reindeer (domesticated or semi-domesticated mountain reindeer, Rangifer tarandus tarandus)
parole.testo: In some way from Proto-Finno-Permic *počaw, probably borrowed from Proto-Indo-Iranian *páću, from Proto-Indo-European *peḱu- (“livestock, especially sheep or cattle”).
